title: Paloma Business Ruling: Charging Extra Seats for Part of a Billing Period
content:
How extra seats added to a Paloma Business account are charged for the billing period depends on the whole months since KYB approval and on the days left in the current billing period, counted from the day the charge is worked out to the last day of the period, both days included. The period's days run from its first day to its last day, both included.

### Ruling

An account approved at least 36 whole months earlier with fewer days left than half the period's days is charged the seats' total times the days left over the period's days, rounded up to the cent; an account approved at least 12 and fewer than 36 whole months earlier with fewer days left than half the period's days is charged half the seats' total, rounded up to the cent; every other account is charged the seats' total in full. The seats' total is the users charged multiplied by the per-seat fee. The extra seat charge is the result, rounded up to the cent where this ruling says so and otherwise half up to the cent.

### Decision table

| Whole months since KYB approval | Days left fewer than half the period's days | Charge for the period |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | Yes | Seats' total multiplied by days left over the period's days, rounded up to the cent |
| 12 to 35 | Yes | Half the seats' total, rounded up to the cent |
| Fewer than 12 | Yes | The seats' total in full |
| Any | No | The seats' total in full |

### Day-count cases (hypothetical period of 30 days, 10 June to 9 July)

- Charge worked out 26 June: days left from 26 June through 9 July, 14; half the period is 15; 14 is fewer, so the period ruling applies.
- Charge worked out 25 June: 15 days left, not fewer than 15; the seats' total in full.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Seats' total | Approval | Days left of period days | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18.00 USD | 40 whole months | 14 of 30 | 18.00 multiplied by 14 over 30 is 8.40 USD |
| 25.00 USD | 40 whole months | 13 of 31 | 10.4838..., rounded up to 10.49 USD |
| 18.75 USD | 20 whole months | 14 of 30 | Half is 9.375, rounded up to 9.38 USD |
| 18.75 USD | 8 whole months | 14 of 30 | 18.75 USD in full |
